amendmentReason: The independent run distinguished the character-set whitespace class used for storage diagnostics from the single pad character used for comparisons. Retain every previous case and add literal ASCII whitespace and non-ASCII whitespace to the finite product.
scope: Assign a native VARCHAR field, a plain utf8mb4 literal or NULL to a resolved native VARCHAR field in an ordinary single-table UPDATE. Observe exact storage conversions and ordered assignments with the fixed external table definitions.

Mutation/TextUpdateAssignment.role: One native text assignment in the order of a single-table UPDATE.
Mutation/TextUpdateAssignment.structure: A native VARCHAR write slot and a VARCHAR read slot, plain UTF-8 text literal or NULL.
Mutation/TextUpdateAssignment.conditions: Any read or write slot is relative to occurrence zero. The owning UPDATE checks both slots against the resolved VARCHAR layout before publication. The target has a known character capacity, nullability and stock utf8mb4_bin collation.
Mutation/TextUpdateAssignment.meaning: Read the current row at this assignment position. Store no more Unicode characters than the destination allows. NULL stores as NULL on a nullable destination and as the empty string on a required destination, with a warning in the latter case. A field-to-field copy with the same VARCHAR length-prefix width emits Warning for any truncation. General string storage emits Note for discarded ASCII whitespace only, and Warning when another character is discarded. The native utf8mb4 diagnostic classification recognizes U+0009 through U+000D and U+0020.
Mutation/TextUpdateAssignment.sql: Emit the exact native write name, equality delimiter and exact read slot or literal. Emit assignments in their written order.

structure: The native VARCHAR layout stores capacity, collation and nullability for each resolved physical text slot. An UPDATE stores an ordered list of typed assignments and a scoped predicate.
conditions: A text slot belongs to the ordinary physical target. Static nullability is known. A text assignment accepts text or NULL and a signed assignment accepts signed roles. Directly constructed values and analyzed SQL meet the same boundary.
meaning: Evaluate the predicate on each original row and process selected rows in native single-table order. Later assignments observe the row as changed by earlier ones. Maintain exact text including trailing spaces and preserve NULL, multiplicity and unaffected rows. Compare original and final stored values for the changed-row count.
sql: Render stock single-table UPDATE with each exact resolved target and value. Leave storage conversion to the pinned native statement semantics.
observations: Exact before, after and restored table rows including raw bytes, NULL, unchanged rows and column order
Native changed-row count and zero result columns
After-update trigger events with exact old and new typed values

Warning severity, code, destination column and multiplicity for truncation and required NULL substitution. The raw diagnostics include physical row numbers; unordered row identities do not make those numbers semantic.

finite.completeness: Recover the exact destination, operand role and filter placement from the constructed UPDATE. Compare the entire destination × input × predicate product with distinct finite IDs.

exploration.requiredForms: Vary one to five ordered assignments, same-field and cross-field reads, repeated targets, multibyte, NUL and padding boundaries, each destination capacity, NULL substitution, mixed signed writes text predicates and one-byte versus two-byte VARCHAR length prefixes.
